info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Terminal Management API
info.description: The Terminal Management API provides the functionality to update existing terminal configurations within the system. This endpoint allows for the modification of specific attributes related to a terminal identified by its unique terminal ID. Typical users of this API include system administrators and integration developers who maintain terminal settings for optimal performance. By utilizing this API, businesses can effectively manage and enhance their terminal functionalities in real-time to meet operational demands.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific terminal identified by its unique resource ID. Make sure to provide the necessary information in the request body to successfully modify the terminal's attributes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of the terminal identified by RES-100045. The provided data must conform to the specified schema to ensure proper processing of the update request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, terminal details updated.
